# Fixture sources (sensors)

| File | Origin | Licence |
|---|---|---|
| `lmsensors_laptop.json` | Real `sensors -j` output, lm-sensors test suite: https://github.com/lm-sensors/lm-sensors/blob/master/prog/sensors/test/data/laptop-j.json | GPL-2.0-or-later |
| `lmsensors_laptop_err.json` | Same machine with a sensor read error: https://github.com/lm-sensors/lm-sensors/blob/master/prog/sensors/test/data/laptop-err-j.json | GPL-2.0-or-later |
| `hwmon_lmsensors_laptop.txt` | Generated by running the collector's `dw_sysfs` globs (40-sensors.sh) over the lm-sensors test sysfs tree `prog/sensors/test/data/laptop` (the same machine as `laptop-j.json`), paths shown as `/sys/class/hwmon/...` | GPL-2.0-or-later (data) |
| `hwmon_node_exporter.txt` | Generated the same way from prometheus/node_exporter `collector/fixtures/sys.ttar` (coretemp ×2, nct6779, test chips "bogus"/"foosensor"): https://github.com/prometheus/node_exporter/blob/master/collector/fixtures/sys.ttar | Apache-2.0 |
| `lmsensors_amd_nct6798.json` | Real `sensors -j` of an AMD desktop board (k10temp, nct6798, jc42 with unconfigured limits and alarm bits set): https://github.com/blicero/medusa/blob/0bce5d20405f64fbe6fea2975de9af967b857b03/probe/sensors-j.output.schwarzgeraet | no licence stated in that repository; tool output used as test data |
| `lmsensors_u_fujitsu_rx300s7.txt` | Real `sensors -u -A` of a Fujitsu PRIMERGY RX300 S7 (2 × Xeon, i350, power_meter): https://github.com/MetricsHub/community-connectors/blob/8d32bf66ec66a46f5c15c416b4cce55aa7282420/src/it/resources/Lmsensors/emulation/command/f4390d80-facf-407a-bb52-6cd6e57f8513.txt | AGPL-3.0 (repository) |
| `lmsensors_u_telegraf.txt` | Mock `sensors -A -u` from influxdata/telegraf `plugins/inputs/sensors/sensors_test.go` (acpitz with a bogus 31.3 °C crit, atk0110 labels with a leading space) | MIT |
| `lmsensors_u_server_faults.txt` | Derived from `lmsensors_u_fujitsu_rx300s7.txt` (Package id 1 set to 92 °C, Core 3 of socket 0 to 85 °C) plus an `nct6776` block synthesized in the `sensors -u` format with fault values: stopped fan with a minimum, slow fan, +12V out of range, unconfigured AVCC alarm (min = max = 0), SYSTIN alarm with max = 0, AUXTIN -128 °C | synthesized |
| `hwmon_faults.txt` | `hwmon_lmsensors_laptop.txt` with the NVMe Composite raised to 95.85 °C (crit 93.85), coretemp `temp1_crit_alarm=1` and a `device/model` line added | synthesized from the real file |
| `thermal_zones.txt`, `thermal_zones_hot.txt` | Synthesized in the `dw_sysfs` format from the kernel thermal sysfs ABI (millidegree C; trip point types critical/hot/passive/active): https://docs.kernel.org/driver-api/thermal/sysfs-api.html | synthesized |
| `win_thermalzone.json` | Synthesized `MSAcpi_ThermalZoneTemperature` objects (root\wmi; temperatures in tenths of Kelvin) in the DW-Json array shape | synthesized |
| `win_lhm.json` | Synthesized LibreHardwareMonitor WMI `Sensor` objects (SensorType, Name, Value, Min, Max, Parent, Identifier as published by LHM's WMI provider), including the derived "Distance to TjMax" and "Core Average" values that must be ignored | synthesized |
| `win_fan.json` | Synthesized `Win32_Fan` object | synthesized |
| `lmsensors_u_k10temp_epyc_4.18.txt` | Synthesized `sensors -u` of a 2-socket EPYC on a 4.18/4.19-era kernel, from `drivers/hwmon/k10temp.c` at v4.19 (https://github.com/torvalds/linux/blob/v4.19/drivers/hwmon/k10temp.c: `temp1_max` is the constant `70 * 1000`, labels "Tdie"/"Tctl", both visible on Zen); current kernels hide `temp1_max` on Zen (`if (channel \|\| data->is_zen) return 0`) | synthesized |
| (inline in `review_test.go`) lm-sensors 3.5.0 JSON with a leading comma and `nan` | Shape derived from `prog/sensors/chips.c` `print_chip_json` at tag V3-5-0 (https://github.com/lm-sensors/lm-sensors/blob/V3-5-0/prog/sensors/chips.c: `subCnt++` also for unreadable subfeatures; fixed in 3.6.0, see CHANGES "Fixed a stray comma bug in the JSON output") | synthesized |
